systems.platform: online registration linked to the national identity number; technology partner named as Barnksforte Technologies Limited
systems.tiers: used by the Commission's own registrars at registration points in hospitals and primary healthcare centres (one in Sangotedo, Lagos, is described); paper registration discontinued 1 July 2026; decentralisation to local governments and more points at ward and health-facility level are proposed, with the local governments' association to set up further centres

note: The online birth registration described is worked by the National Population Commission's own registrars at health facilities, a national agency's field service; its Sangotedo registrar reports submissions delayed by poor internet. Local governments appear only in a proposed arrangement to decentralise registration to them. No local government office is said to be connected or to work in the system, so no fact.
